table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	St.Icode, 
	AliasName= i.customicode, 
	Item = i.name,  
	Code = i.icatcode, 
	packingdesc=max(i.packingdesc), 
	Name = ic.Name, 
	Rate = Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	StockRate = CASE WHEN :ai_stockprice =1 THEN Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2) ELSE i.Avgprice END,
	openqty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	openvalue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	PurQty 	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	PurBonus  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PV' THEN bonus ELSE 0 END),
	PurValue  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	PRetQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PR' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	PRetBonus =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PR' THEN bonus ELSE 0 END),
	PRetValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PR' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	TodaySale = SUM(CASE WHEN type='TS' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	TodaySR = SUM(CASE WHEN type='TR' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	SaleQty	  = SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	SaleBonus =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN bonus ELSE 0 END),
	SaleValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN 
					CASE :ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN value 
					ELSE Qty * Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2) END ELSE 0 END),
	SRetQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	SRetBonus =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN bonus ELSE 0 END),
	SRetValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN 
					CASE :ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN value 
					ELSE Qty * Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2) END ELSE 0 END),
	InstitutionalSale = SUM(CASE WHEN type='IS' THEN qty WHEN type='IR' THEN -qty ELSE 0 END),
	LastMonthSale = SUM(CASE WHEN type='LMS' THEN qty WHEN type='LMR' THEN -qty ELSE 0 END),
	IssueQty  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='IV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	IssueValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='IV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	DueSatisfyQty  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='DS' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	DueSatisfyValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='DS' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	ReceiptQty=SUM(CASE WHEN type='RV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	ReceiptValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='RV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	AdjQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='AI' THEN qty 
								WHEN type='AD' THEN -qty 
								ELSE 0 END),
	AdjValue  =SUM(CASE  WHEN type='AI' THEN value 
								WHEN type='AD' THEN -value  
								ELSE 0 END)
FROM
	(SELECT type='OP', icode, qty = sum(qty), bonus = 0, value=0
	FROM	(select	pd.icode, qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
														when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
														when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
														else looseqty + bonusqty end, 0))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
	      pl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	pd.icode,
		qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
	      pl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND sd.Due IS NULL
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = -sum(sd.qty)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = sum(sd.qty)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty = -sum(sd.looseqty)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	d.icode,
		qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty)
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
	      h.duesatisfydate < :ar_startdate
	Group By d.icode) A
	GROUP BY icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PV',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(looseqty + packqty * packunits),
		bonus = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN bonusqty * packunits
			when 2 THEN bonusqty * packunits
			else bonusqty
			end, 0)),
		value = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			else looseqty + bonusqty 
			end, 0) * pd.purprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
		pl.date >= :ar_startdate and pl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PR',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(pd.looseqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits) *
			pd.prprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
	      pl.date >= :ar_startdate and pl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SR',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='TS',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
	      CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),sl.date, 101) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),:ar_enddate,101)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='TR',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
	      CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),sl.date, 101) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),:ar_enddate,101)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='LMS',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate - 30 and sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='LMR',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate - 30 and sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='IS',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
		sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate and
		sl.custcode IN (SELECT C.CustCode FROM Customer C, CustomerCategory CC WHERE CC.Name LIKE ('%INST%') AND CC.CustCatCode=C.CustCatCode)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='IR',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate and
		sl.custcode IN (SELECT C.CustCode FROM Customer C, CustomerCategory CC WHERE CC.Name LIKE ('%INST%') AND CC.CustCatCode=C.CustCatCode)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='IV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='DS',
		d.icode,
		qty = sum(d.duesatisfyqty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(d.duesatisfyqty * (d.packsaleprice / case d.packunits when 0 then 1 else d.packunits end))
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode = d.duesatisfycode AND
	      h.duesatisfydate >= :ar_startdate and h.duesatisfydate <= :ar_enddate
	Group By d.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='RV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AI',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AD',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT type='OP', icode, qty = 0, bonus = 0, value=0 FROM ITEM) St, 
	Item i, 
	itemcategory ic
WHERE st.icode = i.icode and
		i.icatcode in (:ar_icatcode) and 
		i.icatcode = ic.icatcode
GROUP BY St.icode, i.name, i.customicode, i.icatcode, ic.Name, i.saleprice, i.packunits, i.Avgprice
ORDER BY ic.name, i.icatcode, i.name, i.customicode, St.icode

objects.name: othervalue

objects.name: compute_17

objects.expression: sum( (openqty * stockrate ) + case( ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN purvalue ELSE (purqty + purbonus) * rate) + case( ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN sretvalue ELSE (sretqty + sretbonus) * rate) for all )

objects.name: compute_21

objects.expression: sum( case( ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN salevalue-sretvalue ELSE (saleqty + salebonus - sretqty - sretbonus) * rate) for all)

objects.expression: sum( case( ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN sretvalue ELSE (sretqty + sretbonus) * rate) for all)

objects.name: compute_13

objects.expression: openqty + purqty + purbonus - pretqty - pretbonus - saleqty - salebonus + sretqty + sretbonus - duesatisfyqty - issueqty + receiptqty + adjqty

objects.expression: case( ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN salevalue-sretvalue ELSE (saleqty + salebonus - sretqty - sretbonus) * rate)

objects.name: compute_15
objects.visible: 1	IF(SUM(( openqty + purqty + purbonus - pretqty - pretbonus - saleqty - salebonus + sretqty + sretbonus - issueqty + receiptqty + adjqty ) * stockrate for group 1)=0, 0, 1)
objects.expression: SUM(( openqty + purqty + purbonus - pretqty - pretbonus - saleqty - salebonus + sretqty + sretbonus - issueqty + receiptqty + adjqty ) * stockrate for group 1)

objects.name: compute_29

objects.expression: sum(  case( ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN purvalue ELSE (purqty + pretbonus)* rate) for group 1)

objects.expression: sum(  case( ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN purvalue ELSE purqty * rate) for group 1)

objects.expression: sum( (openqty * stockrate ) + case( ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN purvalue ELSE (purqty + purbonus) * rate) + case( ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN sretvalue ELSE (sretqty + sretbonus) * rate) for group 1 )

objects.expression: sum( case( ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN salevalue-sretvalue ELSE (saleqty + salebonus - sretqty - sretbonus) * rate) for group 1)
